text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa, haa... Not bad, Big Sis 
Hishiama! That was an amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant* That's my line. The way you 
ran was just like—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—It's a flame! A roaring blaze that gets 
your body and soul burning hot.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Flames?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it wasn't just fast. It wasn't just 
sharp, either. It was... how should I put 
it...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"It's the kind of running that fires up 
both competitors and spectators alike! I 
was totally blown away myself."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Now I understand. Why Brian was able to 
get back on her feet after running with 
you...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Biko, you really are... an Umamusume who 
fires everyone up!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: To fire everyone up...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I see... That's it... That is truly it...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(Watching Carrotman fired me up. And 
instead of just cheering from the 
sidelines...)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(I wanted to be just like that! Thinking 
about making it happen kept me going!)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Not just being strong. Not just saving 
people. That's right, making everyone—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Making people burn with the desire of 'I 
want to be like that!' —that's what makes 
a true hero!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right! Hey, everyone! I'm gonna do it! 
Justice Biko will make it happen!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
From here on, I'll shine as the strongest 
sprint hero, igniting the passion in 
everyone watching!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwoooooooooah!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Biko Pegasus! Biko! Biko!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what a fuss~. Biko-chan, you're 
amazing, so amazing...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm nowhere near ready right now, but... 
one day, I... I want to become just like 
that!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oooh, Biko-chan! Bikooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Such a passionate declaration of being a 
hero. Watching it, Hishi Akebono's own 
dream seemed to ignite and blaze fiercely 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I finally figured out what my 
final form should be!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna become someone everyone looks up 
to! A hero who makes people think, "I want 
to be like her!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, if it's Biko, you can do it!
Yeah, you can definitely become one, Biko!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, to achieve that, she would have 
to become the undisputed champion of the 
sprint division this year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unless you win both the 'Sprinters Stakes' 
and the 'Mile Championship' GⅠs in the 
fall, you can hardly call yourself the 
ultimate hero.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! No more losing from here on out. 
Nothing but straight wins!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So, the big spring races are over now. 
Where should we head next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the two GⅠs, I want her to run in a 
graded race somewhere. If we aim for a 
little before the Sprinters Stakes—
choice_data_list:
Shall we go for the GⅡ Centaur Stakes in 
early autumn?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! The Centaur Stakes! "Centaur" means 
centauros, right? Sounds pretty cool!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right! Then starting from there, the 
Justice Biko broadcast will finally reach 
its climax!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Who is it, who's the final big boss 
standing in my way?! No matter who it is, 
I'll take them down!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus gets hyped up. However, the 
current sprint division is fiercely 
contested...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We still don't know who the evil supreme 
leader waiting at the end truly is.
